title: The path exemption of the closed-value rule passes any slash-bearing secret value that prose closes with a comma or bracket
goal: kbpublic.file_hits flags an unquoted assignment whose value is a mixed-case base64-style string holding slashes and is followed by , ) ] }, while a lower-case path such as kb/public/x.md and a snake_case code name stay unflagged when so closed

run: import sys;sys.path.insert(0,'_tools');import kbpublic as p;v='wJalrXUtnFEM'+'I/K7MDENG/bPxRfiCY';k='sec'+'ret=';ts=[k+v+',','('+k+v+')','the '+k[:-1]+': '+v+', then'];r=[bool([h for h in p.file_hits('kb/public/x.md',t,{}) if h[0]=='secret']) for t in ts];print(r);sys.exit(0 if all(r) else 1)

import sys;sys.path.insert(0,'_tools');import kbpublic as p;a='api_'+'key=';ts=[a+'token_provider,','('+a+'token_provider)','path='+'kb/public/x.md,'];r=[bool([h for h in p.file_hits('kb/public/x.md',t,{}) if h[0]=='secret']) for t in ts];print(r);sys.exit(0 if not any(r) else 1)
